intro: Crossroads Supply Crates contain vital provisions intended for the settlement of the Crossroads in the Barrens. After a caravan was raided along the arid roads, these stolen goods ended up scattered among local Razormane quilboar camps.

p: The crossroads settlement serves as the beating heart of Horde travel through central Kalimdor, but keeping it provisioned across the arid wastes is a constant trial. Caravan routes running through the Barrens are relentlessly stalked by the native Razormane quilboar. During one such ambush, a vital supply shipment destined for the settlement was ransacked. The crates were dragged into the prickly underbrush and dirt dens of nearby quilboar camps, leaving the settlement's commander, Thork, to enlist travelers to recover them before the outpost runs dangerously low on food, tools, and necessities.
